items.sentence: One quiet valley lay between the two green mountains.
Today, ocean winds influence the weather along this rocky coast.
Today, the storm caused small damage to the garden fence.
One lack of rain made the grass turn brown.
Today, scientists predict warm sunny weather for the whole weekend.
Today, the hikers were aware of the changing evening sky.
Today, that was the correct answer to the weather question.
A small earthquake made the teacups rattle very softly.
Before the evening picnic begins, the rain is due.
After rain, the water level in the pond rose.
